scope.selector: fixed original favorable-leaf tags F={v original leaf: Delta_p(T-v)<0}; distinct leaves remain distinct tags
scope.rank: eligible p with x(T)+2<=p and 3p<2 alpha(T)+1
scope.additional_condition: Q>0 for divided formulations; undivided formulation also holds when Q=0

definitions.q_v(k): number of independent k-sets A of H_v meeting W_v, k=p-1
definitions.w(B): number of v in F with v in B and B-{v} meeting W_v
definitions.Q: sum over independent p-sets B of T of w(B) = sum over v in F q_v(p-1)
definitions.e(B): number of vertices addable to independent p-set B in T
definitions.E: sum over independent p-sets B of T of w(B)e(B) = sum over v,A counted by q_v(p-1) of e_Hv(A)

identities: E_p[e]=mu_p by double-counting pairs (B,u) where |B|=p, B independent, and u extends B to an independent (p+1)-set.
E/Q=mu_p+Cov_p(w,e)/E_p[w] when Q>0, for the uniform distribution on independent p-sets.
CT_x i_x E<=(x+1)i_(x+1)Q is equivalent, when Q>0, to Cov_p(w,e)/E_p[w]<=mu_x-mu_p.
Writing I_u(B)=1[B cap N_T[u] is empty], e(B)=sum_u I_u(B), and E_p[I_u]=i_p(T-N_T[u])/i_p(T), gives the vertex-neighborhood covariance expansion recorded in REPORT.md.
proved_bridge: For each tag v, (v,A) maps bijectively to (v,B=A union {v}); meeting W_v blocks its support s_v, so e_Hv(A)=e_T(B). Thus the marked Q,E are exactly the w-weighted rank-p quantities.
strict_descent_observation: Delta_x<0 gives mu_x<x+1 when i_x>0. Eligibility p>=x+2 does not by itself order mu_p and mu_x or bound Cov_p(w,e).
open_obligation: A universal upper bound Cov_p(w,e)/E_p[w]<=mu_x-mu_p under the exact selector and lower-region guards, or another proof/refutation of CT_x.
status_boundary: Exact identities only; no universal CT_x or primary-aggregate verdict.
